relationships.subject: DNAmGrimAge-diff
relationships.evidence_quote: Our main finding was that DNAmGrimAge-diff mediated the associations of income and education with pain impact

relationships.subject: socioeconomic status
relationships.evidence_quote: Here, we show that the SES variables of income and education are associated with the epigenetic clock, DNAmGrimAge.

key_findings: Accelerated epigenetic aging (DNAmGrimAge-diff ~5 years) in high-impact knee pain vs ~1 year in low-impact/no pain.
DNAmGrimAge-diff mediated associations of income and education with pain impact (~48% mediated).
